subject: Re: Pilot commercial model for CloudForge embedded ISV trial
messages:
From: Sarah Goldstein <sarah@cloudforge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot commercial model idea - micro-pay/intro protection

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudForge was really impressed with the latency and cost controls you showed. We discussed running a 3-month embedded pilot where we surface Redwood pricing to our customers via a micro-transaction flows within our admin console.

High-level ask: can Redwood offer a pilot-friendly rev-share that supports (a) micropay per API-call routed via our connector, (b) a 90-day intro-ownership protection window on any converted accounts, and (c) a reconciliation cadence that tolerates small-value payouts (we expect ~60 small debits/week). We can accept a modest holdback (escrow style) on first invoices to protect against rapid churn.

I attached a short pilot scope (cloudforge-pilot-terms-v1.pdf) and a sample intro list. Would love to sync legal/commercial and ops to avoid a lengthy RFP. Proposed timeline: sign this week, pilot starts 5/10.

Open to a short call — copied our Partnerships inbox for scheduling.

Best,
Sarah
VP Partnerships, CloudForge

--
CloudForge
partners@cloudforge.io

Attachments: cloudforge-pilot-terms-v1.pdf, intro-list.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Goldstein <sarah@cloudforge.io>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial model idea - micro-pay/intro protection

Sarah — thanks for the concise brief and attachments. Quick confirmation: Redwood can support per-call micropay routing via our hosted API and emit consolidated monthly invoices or daily activity reports — we typically reconcile monthly for low-value flows.

Two quick asks before we lock timeline:
- Can CloudForge accept a 10% short-term holdback on pilot invoices for the first 60 days to account for refunds/chargebacks?
- Intro-ownership: we typically accept 6- to 12-month attribution windows depending on contract size. For pilots at this scale we can agree to a 9-month protection by default unless you need longer (explain reasoning).

I can loop in Ben (commercial) and Rishi (contracts) to confirm. If that looks OK I’ll send a short summary and DocuSign link for internal signatures to hit your 5/10 start.

—Marissa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Pilot commercial model idea - micro-pay/intro protection

Team — forwarding CloudForge request. TL;DR: small-value micropay flows, wants 90-day intro protection, OK with escrow/holdback. Proposed pilot start 5/10.

Key commercial questions for us:
- Holdback size: Sarah suggested "modest"; I proposed 10% for first 60 days. Ben, is 10% workable from revenue forecasting?
- Intro ownership window: they asked 90 days; I proposed 9 months. Camila, operationally what is easiest to enforce? Can we rely on our demo/intro tracking?
- Reconciliation: they expect many small transactions — do we want to do monthly aggregate payouts with a stub file? Rishi please flag any contract risks.

Please reply with short bullets; I'd like to ship a one-pager and DocuSign by EOD tomorrow so they can hit 5/10.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — quick bullets from commercial: 
- 10% holdback for 60 days is acceptable for a pilot this size; cash flow impact negligible.
- Revenue-share: propose 20% rev-share on net pilot billables (hosted API revenue), paid monthly after holdback. If conversions scale above $30k MRR within 6 months we move to a negotiated tiered split.
- Intro-protection: agree to a 9-month attribution window, but require CloudForge to supply signed MSA or copy of converted contract as proof of conversion. We should also define "converted" (first paid invoice > $500).

Operational note: we need their connector to emit partner_id on requests for deterministic attribution; otherwise we fall back to their intro list (attached). Camila, can your team accept partner_id and do matching?

Ben
Director, Partnerships Revenue 
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot commercial model idea - micro-pay/intro protection

All — legal/compliance notes: 
- Holdback/escrow: 10% short-term holdback OK. Add a cap on retained earnings (e.g., no more than $15k held at any time during pilot) to avoid causing cashflow strain for CloudForge.
- Intro window: 9 months OK but require a mutual tamper-resistant matching flow (partner_id header + hashed email list). Avoid manual-only matching where possible.
- Early termination: include pro-rata unwind for any unpaid usage and a reconciliation period of 30 days post-termination.
- PCI/data note: CloudForge will send hashed identifiers only; ensure we do not require any customer PII in claims. Add SOC 2 reference in the SOW.

Draft language suggestions: I attached inline clauses in the pilot PDF (cloudforge-pilot-terms-v1.pdf). Will prepare a clean DocuSign-ready addendum if Ben/Marissa confirm commercial points.

Rishi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Goldstein <sarah@cloudforge.io>, CloudForge Partnerships <partners@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Summary & next steps: CloudForge pilot (DocuSign enclosed)

Sarah — thanks for patience while we aligned internally. Summary of agreed pilot terms below (short-form):

- Pilot length: 3 months starting on the date of first billed usage.
- Commercial: 20% rev-share to CloudForge on net billed usage during the pilot, paid monthly.
- Holdback: 10% retained on each monthly payout for first 60 days; cap on total retained pilot escrow = $15,000.
- Intro attribution: 9-month protection window for any customer listed in the attached intro-list.csv or identified via partner_id header. Conversion defined as first paid invoice > $500.
- Reconciliation: monthly aggregate reconciliation file; we will issue payments monthly with a 30-day settlement window post-invoice.
- Early termination: pro-rata unwind and 30-day reconciliation period.
- Data: CloudForge will only share hashed identifiers for matching; Redwood will not require PII. SOC 2 reference included in SOW.

Next steps: I attached the final pilot terms (cloudforge-pilot-terms-v1.pdf) with our inline edits and a DocuSign link to execute the addendum: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/1234abcd. Once signed we will enable partner_id in their connector and schedule a kickoff ops call.

If those bullets look good I’ll send the DocuSign to your Partnerships inbox and schedule the ops kick for 5/11 (buffer to allow for signature).

Thanks — excited to get this rolling.

—Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: cloudforge-pilot-terms-v1.pdf, intro-list.csv
